data.body:
Root cause (confirmed in a sandbox store): `_get_link_info` matched a LINK by `stored target_id == resolved input`. `process_link` resolves the stored short target at replay, so `show` lists the full id, but the stored string is still the quad. A quad input resolves to the full id before lookup, so neither form ever equalled the stored quad. `_write_unlink` then passed the resolved id to `_is_active_link`, which compares raw stored targets the same way.

Fix (`src/rebar/_commands/unlink.py`): a stored target matches when it equals the resolved input or resolves (quiet) to that same ticket now. `_find_link` returns the raw stored target too, and `_write_unlink` hands that raw string to `_is_active_link`, so the active check stays exact. An ambiguous stored quad resolves to nothing and a quad of another ticket resolves to that ticket, so neither can match. The 3262 exact-string path for unresolvable inputs is unchanged.

Tests: `tests/unit/test_unlink_resolved_short_target_conch.py` (10 cases). 7 failed before the fix with the reported "no LINK event found" error, and all 10 pass after it, along with the 7 tests from 3262.
